description: AutoPoco is a highly configurable framework for the purpose of fluently building readable test data from Plain Old CLR Objects. This is a modernized (i.e. net6 and higher) port of the excellent AutoPoco project which hasn't been maintained since 2014.
releaseNotes: 6.0: Lambda data sources (FuncSource, Setup(...).From(() => ...), Source(expr, () => ...) at generation time). Opt-in nullability-aware null generation via RespectNullableAnnotations(threshold). Generic NumberSource<T> and NullableNumberSource<T> with min/max for every built-in numeric type (integers uniform and inclusive, floating point and decimal overflow safe). Records and immutable types are constructed through their constructor, parameters are fed from the registered members with the same name, no parameterless constructor needed anymore; unconfigured struct parameters stay default instead of throwing. Seeds: UseSeed(seed) per factory, CreateSession(recursionLimit, seed) per session, every member gets its own stream derived from the seed. Own deterministic generator (StableRandom, xoshiro256**) instead of System.Random, sequences are stable across .NET versions. Breaking: AutoPocoGlobalSettings removed (AutoPocoDefaults constants instead), every generated sequence changed once, the max of IntegerSource/LongSource/RandomNumberSource and their nullable variants is inclusive now (it was exclusive), Int128Source/NullableInt128Source pick uniformly instead of clamping to the bounds (they never produced a negative value before), RandomStringSource and UrlSource reach the last character resp. the last top level domain, ColorSource/RandomTextSource/RandomUtfTextSource treat their maximum as inclusive, ColorSource applies the alpha of SetColorRange, and UrlSource and ExtendedEmailAddressSource seed their nested sources (the URL host ignored the session seed completely). CreditCardSource never produced a Discover card. TimeSpanSource was rewritten: it returned TimeSpan.MinValue on every draw of the default range, produced values outside a requested range and looped forever on a reversed one. DoubleSource returned infinity over its default range, DoubleSource/FloatSource/DecimalSource interpolate overflow safe now and DecimalSource keeps its full precision. Index-aware Impose on lists and selections (value from the position, or from position and item), Impose(member, item => value) on a single generator. Invoke arguments: Use.From(lambda), constants and variables arrive as values. Context lambdas get a non-nullable IGenerationContext. Argument validation over the public API, meaningful exception messages, XML documentation file. IDataSource<T> is covariant. Bug fixes: Nullable* sources honor an explicit null creation threshold (null positions of stable sequences changed), DateTime/DateOnly/TimeOnly/DateOfBirth sources cover their whole range including the upper bound (sequences changed), RandomUtfTextSource no longer loops forever. Build and packaging modernized: GitHub Actions CI, trusted publishing to nuget.org, MinVer tag based versioning, central package management, xunit.v3 tests on net8/9/10. FluentAssertions and Moq are no longer dependencies of the library. See README for details.
title: AutoPoco by holonsoft
